events.description: Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing played a game earlier and she asks how it was.

Monica Geller says she is questioning how it was possible that Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing won the game.
Ross Geller says Alan was unbelievable in the game, like Bugs Bunny playing all the positions, with Alan effectively covering first base, second base, and third base.
